demo_banner: Simulated data. No wallets or real funds.
demo_reset_description: Restore the sample bounties, profiles, and balances in this browser. Your theme and language will stay the same.
demo_confirm_description: Preview the transaction flow safely. This action only changes sample data in your browser.
demo_pending_description: Simulating confirmation. No transaction is being sent to a blockchain.
demo_success_description: Simulation complete. The demo status and virtual balances have been updated.
demo_rejected_description: Request declined in the simulation. Nothing changed; you can try again.
demo_failed_description: A simulated transaction failure. No data or virtual balances changed; retry when ready.
demo_profile_intro: Explore a sample profile. Profile edits, theme, and language are saved in this browser.
demo_wallet_info: This is a virtual balance for exploring the product. The full application supports account sign-in, linked wallets, and on-chain escrow. This demo never connects a wallet.
demo_limit: The demo has reached its limit of 64 bounties. Reset the demo to start fresh.
demo_role_hint: Switch roles above to explore both sides of a bounty.
demo_try_flow: Create a bounty, switch to the other profile to accept it, then return to the creator to release the reward.
demo_no_activity: Your simulated transactions will appear here. Open a bounty to try the flow.
demo_page_missing: This bounty is not in your demo yet.
demo_not_available: This action is not available for the current profile and bounty status.
demo_invalid_input: Check the title, description, selected skills, and reward. Profile names are required and websites must use HTTP or HTTPS.
demo_storage_error: Browser storage is unavailable. You can explore, but changes may be lost when you reload.
